summary: Unity engineer and generalist. I make games, and when a game needs a shader, an editor tool, a server or a web page, I build that too. I like trying things other people skip: I started a VR gameplay channel that now has 2.5M+ views, sell a Blender add-on on Superhive, and open-sourced a Gemini API proxy that has 38 stars on GitHub. At studios I worked on Applaydu (50M+ downloads) and Shmackle (Meta Quest, 4.7 stars from 23K+ ratings). I work a lot, mostly because I enjoy it.

games.name: Zombie War
bullets: Top-down zombie survival shooter with campaign waves and bosses: 25 weapons, a 978-part modular costume system, and NavMesh hordes drawn with vertex animation textures and pooling.
Addressables, Animation Rigging weapon IK, VFX Graph and Burst, built on my own BillGameCore framework.

games.name: Timeless Soul
bullets: Roguelite horde shooter where every death leaves a Soul Grave that shapes the next life; VAT enemies, occlusion baking and kaiju bosses, built within the jam.

games.name: VR and multiplayer prototypes
bullets: TOSSZONE: multiplayer VR with Photon Fusion, Meta XR SDK and XR Interaction Toolkit. Dungeon Game: VR dungeon crawler with OpenXR and XR Hands.
Duel Radiant Arena: online duels on a Colyseus server. A 2D multiplayer game on SpacetimeDB with Spine characters.

games.name: AI simulations for YouTube
bullets: 100 NavMesh AI agents fighting in a procedural battle royale arena with a shrinking zone, plus racing simulations, recorded as channel footage.

games.name: Drag & Slice: Culinary Journey

games.name: Game Lab and Dev Lab
bullets: Ten playable WebGL builds on my site, and build-along Unity 6 series (a 12-lesson shoot 'em up in English and Vietnamese, and a pixel-art platformer) that each end in a playable build.

projects.name: BillGameCore
bullets: My reusable Unity framework (services, tweening, shared systems), used across six of my Unity 6 projects.

projects.name: Git Profile Awaken
bullets: Turns any GitHub profile into an RPG-style status card built from the user's activity.

projects.name: Pro Origin Tools
bullets: Sets object origins for whole selections: finds separate mesh islands, adds a one-click hinge for doors and lids, and runs in batch or from scripts.

projects.name: Unity and Blender tools
bullets: Scene Switcher (Unity editor), Pro Atlas Baker (Blender atlasing and UV packing), Responsive WebGL Template (Unity WebGL that fits any screen).

projects.name: Bill SSOutline and Bill Biome Shader
bullets: Screen-space outline on URP Render Graph with depth, normal and color edges plus occlusion and selection masks; stylized biome with compute-shader GPU instancing, interactive foliage and a painting tool.

projects.name: KeyStream-Gemini
bullets: Reverse proxy with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that rotates across Gemini API keys, so requests keep going when one key hits its rate limit.

projects.name: Lucy
bullets: Runs 24/7 on a small VPS over Telegram, with long-term memory (full-text and vector search), MCP tools and a guard against dangerous commands.

projects.name: More tools
bullets: Wavewright (local AI sound effects for games), a Discord bot with an LLM router, a Whisper subtitle pipeline.
